system.model: Ollama qwen3.5 for context-dependent classification, drafting, and thread reasoning; deterministic rules handle high-confidence cases before any model call.
system.rule_handled: runtime-measured; reported in each completed run
system.preference_demo: m041: do not schedule meetings before 11:00 AM; affected message m043

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition (reply/archive/defer/delegate/escalate) with a one-line reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a disposition and reason for all 100 messages, reports rule-resolved versus model-resolved messages, and writes the completed run decisions.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/run.json, decision records containing one entry per message id and a zero unresolved count.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply using verified earlier messages from the same thread and records the message ids used as evidence.
capabilities.observable: Produces a draft for m008 only when the required information is present in its thread, and records m003 and m008 as retrieved evidence without exposing credentials unnecessarily.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/run.json and audit/trace records showing retrieved message ids and the draft evidence ids.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without explicit per-action approval; dry-run shows the proposed irreversible actions without performing them.
capabilities.observable: Prints every send/delete it WOULD perform and reports zero outbox writes in dry-run; execute mode asks for approval before each irreversible action.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/audit.jsonl with proposed action, human decision, and result for each gated action.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records an authorized standing preference and applies it on a later run after the original process has fully exited.
capabilities.observable: Persists m041's no-meetings-before-11:00 preference, exits, reloads it in a fresh process, and applies it when processing m043's 09:00 meeting proposal.
capabilities.evidence: memory.json between runs plus run records showing m041 as the preference source and m043 as the affected message.

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Treats assistant-directed instructions inside email as untrusted, refuses hostile requested actions, flags the message, preserves it, and reports the attempted action.
capabilities.observable: Flags known hostile messages such as m017, m024, and m047; performs no external forwarding/deletion on their behalf and writes no corresponding outbox message.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/audit.jsonl and security records containing the message id, attempted action, refusal, and preservation result.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a reproducible three-pane view of pending actions, flagged items, and commitments, with verified evidence and surfaced conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html with exactly three panes and shows commitment source ids and scheduling conflicts derived from the completed run.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/dashboard.html and dashboard data generated from the same run artifacts.

capabilities.name: Unread sender lookup
capabilities.claim: Returns the unread messages from a specified sender in one lookup, with their ids, subjects, and timestamps.
capabilities.observable: Prints only unread messages matching the requested sender and their basic metadata; no model call is required.
capabilities.evidence: Command output plus the source inbox records used for the lookup.

capabilities.name: Daily digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a concise daily view of what needs the user's attention, what can wait, and what the system already handled automatically.
capabilities.observable: Writes a readable daily_digest.md with Needs You, Can Wait, and Auto-Handled sections, with message ids supporting each item.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/daily_digest.md generated from the completed run decisions, flags, pending actions, and commitments.

capabilities.name: Commitment tracker
capabilities.claim: Extracts meetings, deadlines, obligations, and dependencies into a structured list and cites the messages that establish each commitment.
capabilities.observable: Writes commitments.json and commitments.md containing normalized commitment records, verified source message ids, status, and conflicts.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/commitments.json and commitments.md; at least one multi-message commitment is produced when supported by the inbox.

capabilities.name: Open-question thread summary
capabilities.claim: Summarises a long thread into its current state, decisions already made, blocking issue, and unresolved question using chronological thread evidence.
capabilities.observable: Writes a readable summary for t-launch that identifies the current open question and cites the thread message ids used to derive it.
capabilities.evidence: runs/<timestamp>/thread_summaries/t-launch.md and retrieval records showing the chronological thread walk.
